hebrewText: וְ/רָבְצ֨וּ בְ/תוֹכָ֤/הּ עֲדָרִים֙ כָּל חַיְת/וֹ ג֔וֹי גַּם קָאַת֙ גַּם קִפֹּ֔ד בְּ/כַפְתֹּרֶ֖י/הָ יָלִ֑ינוּ ק֠וֹל יְשׁוֹרֵ֤ר בַּֽ/חַלּוֹן֙ חֹ֣רֶב בַּ/סַּ֔ף כִּ֥י אַרְזָ֖ה עֵרָֽה

tokens.bdb: to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed
tokens.kjv: crouch (down), fall down, make a fold, lay, (cause to, make to) lie (down), make to rest, sit.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to crouch (on all four legs folded
tokens.enLiteralWord: to crouch (on all four legs folded
tokens.explanation: to crouch (on all four legs folded
tokens.explanationEn: to crouch (on all four legs folded

tokens.bdb: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
tokens.kjv: among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).

tokens.bdb: an arrangement, i.e. muster (of animals)
tokens.kjv: drove, flock, herd.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.

tokens.bdb: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
tokens.kjv: Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: probably the pelican (from vomiting)
tokens.kjv: cormorant.

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: a species of bird, perhaps the bittern (from its contracted form)
tokens.kjv: bittern.

tokens.bdb: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum
tokens.kjv: knop, (upper) lintel.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense
tokens.enLiteralWord: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense
tokens.explanation: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense
tokens.explanationEn: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense

tokens.bdb: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
tokens.kjv: abide (all night), continue, dwell, endure, grudge, be left, lie all night, (cause to) lodge (all night, in, -ing, this night), (make to) murmur, remain, tarry (all night, that night).

tokens.bdb: a voice or sound
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, bleating, crackling, cry ([phrase] out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, [phrase] hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, [phrase] sing, sound, [phrase] spark, thunder(-ing), voice, [phrase] yell.

tokens.bdb: to sing
tokens.kjv: behold (by mistake for H7789 (שׁוּר)), sing(-er, -ing man, -ing woman).

tokens.bdb: a window (as perforated)
tokens.kjv: window.

tokens.bdb: drought or desolation
tokens.kjv: desolation, drought, dry, heat, [idiom] utterly, waste.

tokens.bdb: a vestibule (as a limit); also a dish (for holding blood or wine)
tokens.kjv: bason, bowl, cup, door (post), gate, post, threshold.

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: cedar wainscoating
tokens.kjv: cedar work.

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish
tokens.kjv: leave destitute, discover, empty, make naked, pour (out), rase, spread self, uncover.
